notes.title: GLOBAL CONFLICT
notes.notes:
Comrades!

The test mode of the Global Map in September ended with a complete and unconditional victory for the USSR! Thank you all for participating!

All participants of the USSR receive 500 equipment, and the first five receive 1500 equipment and a rare trophy, which will help you get new generals (in a week all the technical aspects will be completed and you will see the trophy in your personal file).

And now starts a new round! The map is already in play, I wonder who will win this time!

notes.title: GLOBAL CONFLICT
notes.notes:
Comrades!
 
A new mode has been launched: Global Conflict!
 
Engage in a large-scale battle of all players!
Choose your side of the conflict, win battles, and use your victories to advance your allied forces!
 
Even a small victory can change the course of the war!
 
P.S. All players on the winning side will receive rewards.

notes.title: UPDATE: V.230875
notes.notes:
Friends!

We're sorry that we haven't pleased you with updates for a long time, but now we're back on track and in a hurry to share the news!

We finally became free of our obligations and are releasing the Russian version of the game on Steam! Hooray!

Also in the news: translation of our military encyclopedia into German and fixing of errors in Chinese localization. (Friends, unfortunately we do not speak these languages well enough, so please do not judge, and if you find a mistake, please let us know about it)

And also pleased to present you the new generals:

Vinogradov
Condition: Play X recon/sabotage units during the match
Ability: Take all enemy's initiative and add it to yourself.

Varentsov
Condition: Keep Artillery units on both flanks and keep them undamaged for two turns
Ability: Artillery barrage. Deliver 10 damage to the enemy HQ.

Hoth
Condition: Combined HP of your Tank units is equal or above X
Ability: All available Tank units get 2 extra moves each.

Richthofen
Condition: Play 2 air units during three turns
Ability: Air superiority. All enemy air units, both in their hand and deck, will be destroyed. All enemy units on the battlefield will lose one health point.

See you on the battlefield!

About Card Blitz: WWII

WWII card game - simple but deep, challenging but friendly. If you are into military history, collecting, and fast game sessions then Card Blitz is perfect for you! Dive into the harsh world of ruthless and historical card battles! Collect troops and trophies. Gather legendary generals under your command!

*Over 150 cards: tanks, infantry, aircraft, artillery, support units, and generals!
*Welcome history figures to your army: Rommel and Rokossovsky are yours to command!
*Fight against other players and earn well-deserved trophies!
*Learn, adapt, collect, and build the legendary deck!
